description: The file defines the class 'Proxy' within the namespace 'Opencart\System\Engine'. It provides a proxy pattern implementation with magic methods for property access and method calls, designed to wrap around instances of models implementing the 'Model' interface. The class includes methods for dynamic property get/set, checking existence, unset, and handling method calls via __call.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A proxy class implementing dynamic property and method access to wrap around Model objects, enabling flexible interaction with models.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Provides dynamic access to properties stored in the internal data array, throwing an exception if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Allows setting properties dynamically, storing them in the internal data array.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a property exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a property from the internal data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls; invokes corresponding methods on stored objects if available, otherwise throws an exception.
